player_prompt.intro:
Jumamasa {color} saraña Breakthrough pukllaypi. {direction} saraña {board_size}x{board_size} pampa ukjamarakï. 
Q'araña, maya p'iqi kimsa t'aqaña, qullasña chiqpachaña chiqanxaña. 
P'iqi kimsa t'aqaña chiqpachaña, juk'amp maya p'iqi jan maya ukjamarakï, ukjamarakï chiqpachaña chiqanxaña. 
Maya p'iqi ukjamarakï jan maya p'iqi chiqanxaña, jumamasa jan maya p'iqi jark'aña, jan maya p'iqi pampa ukjamarakï jark'aña. 
UCI-jan uñt'atï [a2a3] uka p'iqi a2 ukjamarakï a3 ukjamarakï saraña. 
* 'a' uka q'araña pampa ch'iqanxaña, '1' uka q'araña juk'amp saraña (jallu uñt'atï). 
* Ch'iyara q'araña pampa juk'amp saraña (8 q'araña 8x8). Jallu q'araña pampa juk'amp saraña (1 q'araña 8x8). 
Maya p'iqi jan maya p'iqi chiqanxaña, jumamasa juk'amp saraña.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jani ukaxa, mä paréntesis algebraica ukjam [a2a3] apnaqapxama.
invalid_move.illegal: Uka amtarux janiw jaysapktati, jan ukax uka ayllux janiw jumankkiti.

outcome.white_reached: Janq'u jaqinakax ch'iyar jaqinaka taypiruw puripxi.
outcome.black_reached: Ch'iyar jaqinakax janq'u jaqinakan nayrïr siqiparuw puripxi.
